metadata.description: A project-agnostic expert team for Claude Code that learns across projects.

plugins.name: startup-team
plugins.description: A small expert team for any project: tech lead, architect, designer, executor, QA, auditor, devops and security agents, one session per role, shipping and operations skills, project-rule hooks, turn folders, shared memory and an owner-approved learning loop. After installing, Claude says "startup-team installed successfully." and asks whether to create the AI Tech Lead session and its six sub sessions (1 = yes, 0 = no); see the README, "After installing".
